title: Root purpose
desc: Top-level anchor for all HAVEN purposes.

title: Digital work
desc: Purposes that help people or scaffolds coordinate, collect, share or inspect digital work.

title: Decision-support analysis
desc: Set up structured analysis for a problem when the user needs depth, evidence, disagreement and an actionable recommendation.

title: Problem framing
desc: Clarify the question, scope, stakeholders, constraints, success criteria and missing context before analysis starts.

title: Advisory panel
desc: Use distinct advisory roles with guardrails when a problem benefits from multiple perspectives instead of one monolithic answer.

title: Evidence ledger
desc: Separate textual claims, external source status, assumptions and non-checkable judgments.

title: Synthesis and recommendation
desc: Combine panel findings into options, tradeoffs, confidence and an actionable recommendation.

title: Meta-evaluation
desc: Assess whether the analysis is good enough for the decision context and what remains uncertain.

title: Capability delivery
desc: Resolve a user's requested functionality into an existing visible configuration, a new CellConfiguration draft, or a reviewed feature request.

title: Reuse visible CellConfiguration
desc: Prefer an existing visible CellConfiguration when it can satisfy the user's purpose.

title: Construct CellConfiguration
desc: Draft a CellConfiguration over existing cells, keypaths and supported skeleton elements when no existing surface fits.

title: Request new functionality
desc: Capture a feature request with purpose, interests, missing capabilities and acceptance goals when existing cells/configurations cannot satisfy it.

title: Human review for capability gap
desc: Queue capability gaps for human review, prioritization and approval instead of forcing the user through many low-value messages.

title: Coordinate work
desc: Plan, coordinate, share and track work across people, agents or scaffolds.

title: Project work overview and sharing
desc: Manage projects, tasks, sharing and current outstanding work.

title: Project portfolio
desc: Track project status, health, priorities, milestones, releases and capacity.

title: Work items
desc: Track tasks, bugs, decisions, comments, subtasks, relations and blockers.

title: Share selected project intent
desc: Prepare, deliver and open a selected project/work snapshot for a recipient.

title: Current status and outstanding work
desc: Show where a project stands now and what remains outstanding.

title: Collect structured input
desc: Collect structured answers or evidence from people or systems.

title: Complete questionnaire campaign
desc: Create, deliver, answer, inspect and analyze a questionnaire campaign.

title: Respondent questionnaire form
desc: Expose consent, questions, draft save, submit and withdrawal paths.

title: Questionnaire admin authoring
desc: Configure title, context, consent, questions, pages and lifecycle.

title: Questionnaire delivery and consent
desc: Select recipients, send access-proof links and preserve consent boundaries.

title: Collect questionnaire responses
desc: Store draft/submitted answers with consent state and receipt IDs.

title: Analyze questionnaire responses
desc: Inspect counts and export response data transparently.

title: Quality
desc: Cross-cutting quality purposes that support user-facing and scaffold-facing work.

title: Functional accessible GUI
desc: Ensure controls are labeled, focusable, visually stable and wired to real actions.

title: Governance
desc: Cross-cutting privacy, access, audit and owner-control purposes.

title: Access, audit and privacy
desc: Keep visibility grant-bound and mutations auditable.

title: Questionnaire access audit
desc: Keep questionnaire responses consent-gated and transport payloads minimal.

title: Owner-controlled preferences
desc: Keep reusable preference facts explicit, scoped and deletable.

title: Validation
desc: Purposes that prove behavior through acceptance, contract and regression checks.

title: Acceptance tests
desc: Prove that a purpose can be achieved and stays stable.

title: Purpose decomposition acceptance
desc: Protect deterministic prompt decomposition and model-proposal boundaries.

title: Questionnaire acceptance tests
desc: Protect questionnaire decomposition and campaign behavior.

title: Project work acceptance tests
desc: Protect project/work decomposition and cell behavior.

title: Knowledge and methodology
desc: Purposes that provide source evidence, freshness, methodology context, and owner-scoped context graphs.

title: Current methodology sources
desc: Use source evidence with checked dates and stale-source policy.

title: Grounding
desc: Purposes that map prompts to executable, verified action plans.

title: Local model assisted decomposition
desc: Use a local model as proposal engine while HAVEN keeps deterministic authority.

title: Unknown prompt purpose
desc: Fallback when the prompt has no known canonical purpose yet.
